section_summary.extract_value: This section details the correlations between participants' semantic distance values and their performance on a divergent thinking task. It reports that cued semantic distance values significantly predicted divergent thinking total scores and its dimensions (flexibility, fluency, and originality), while uncued semantic distance values did not. The results were presented in Table 2 and Fig. 2.
